sections.titre: Here, we look after the estate every day
sections.texte:
Ecology is not a selling point for us: it is how we look after the estate, day after day.

The big trees have had time to grow, we simply opened 25 pitches in that setting, with no mobile homes or entertainment, and we keep the gestures simple.

items.texte: Drinking water is tested by an approved laboratory, and we use it sparingly: no car washing.
Sorting (glass, plastic, metal, paper) is done along the path.
Green waste goes into the two compost bins.
Stale bread and peelings go to the hens: nothing is wasted.

sections.titre: With your tent, or with nothing at all

items.texte: Large, shaded and at least 5 metres apart, for tents, caravans or motorhomes. Hot showers, accessible facilities, Wi-Fi and a playground.
